title: Kubernetes DevOps Engineer (Claude Code) for Infrastructure Takeover
description:
Title:
DevOps / Kubernetes Engineer (Claude Code) – Secure Takeover of Production Infrastructure (1 Month Full-Time, then Ongoing)

Description:
We run an AI SaaS platform with live paying customers, and we're taking over the infrastructure from the previous technical team. We need an experienced DevOps engineer to take full control of the setup, secure it, and keep it running reliably. Speed matters to us: we want someone who uses Claude Code day to day to investigate and fix problems fast.

PHASE 1: FIRST MONTH (FULL-TIME)
• Take over the existing infrastructure using the handover documentation from the previous team
• Run a full security audit: find and remove every user account, SSH key, API key, token and remote access route that isn't ours
• Change all passwords, secrets and credentials across servers, Kubernetes, GitHub, hosting and third-party services
• Review the Kubernetes cluster setup, deployments and configuration
• Set up reliable, tested backups, and confirm we can restore from them
• Set up monitoring and alerts so we know when something breaks
• Move one instance from a third party's servers onto our own infrastructure
• Write clear documentation and runbooks, so we're never dependent on one person again

PHASE 2: ONGOING (PART-TIME)
• Keep the lights on: monitoring, restarts, updates and security patches
• Diagnose and fix issues quickly as they come up
• Help with small infrastructure tasks
• Be available for urgent issues

CURRENT STACK
• Kubernetes
• Linode (Akamai)
• GitHub
• Claude Code and AI agents used for parts of day-to-day operations
• Backups with backblaze

REQUIREMENTS
• Strong production Kubernetes experience
• Hands-on experience using Claude Code to investigate, debug and fix infrastructure issues, and the judgment to check its work before applying changes to production
• A track record of fixing production problems fast
• Proven experience with security hardening, access audits and credential rotation
• Experience taking over infrastructure built by someone else
• Backup and disaster recovery setup
• Linux server administration
• Clear communication in English, and good documentation habits
• Willing to sign an NDA

NICE TO HAVE
• Experience with Linode and OVH
• Experience supporting AI or LLM-based products

TO APPLY, PLEASE ANSWER (in the description)
1. Describe how you use Claude Code to investigate and fix a production issue. Give a real example, and explain how you check its changes before they go live.
2. Describe a time you took over infrastructure from another team. How did you make sure all previous access was removed?
3. How would you approach the first 48 hours on a Kubernetes setup you've never seen before?
4. What's your availability for full-time work in the first month, and your hourly rate for the ongoing part-time work?
5. What time zone are you in?
